structured.approach: The refusal was G2 only: four claims cited repository files that had not been read in the refused session. To fix it, I re-read tests/test_risk.py, tests/test_forecast.py and ci.py with Read in this session. I also re-ran `/usr/bin/python3 ci.py` and `git status` so the CI figures come from a fresh tool result; the result is the same as in attempt 1. No test or code changed. I rewrote task.unit_tests.md in full for attempt 2, with a refusal-fix note and a source on every table and statement. The source is file:ap_forecast/... for the test files and ci.py, tool:repo for the code and the CI run, and the inputs task.code and feat.stories for the plan and the acceptance criteria. The tests themselves stay as before: they map one-to-one to AC-03.1–AC-03.8 and AC-04.1–AC-04.5, and they test the 30 and 10 boundaries explicitly, following L-007.

claims.text: A new tests/test_risk.py adds VendorRiskTest with 6 tests for vendor_risk, covering AC-03.1 to AC-03.8, including the exact 30 and 10 boundaries.

tests/test_forecast.py gains test_request_with_risk and test_request_without_risk_unchanged for AC-04.1 to AC-04.5; the existing tests test_predict, test_request_uses_config and test_request_with_explicit_config are unchanged.
Boundary tests run on the rounded prediction: predict_delay_days([30, 31]) is 30, which gives 'medium', and predict_delay_days([10, 11]) is 10, which gives 'low'.
The CI run in this step reports compile true, 11 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, coverage 100.0, no static issues and passed true.
Before this step, CI failed only on coverage: 83.3, with risk.py lines 17-20 and explain.py line 21 not covered.
The CI coverage gate is COVERAGE_MIN = 90.0; the workbook action asks for at least 90 percent code coverage.
The tests need no secret, credential or network call in any environment; models.json holds only provider, model and max_tokens.
Per feat.stories SA-6, a lane may add new test files instead of using the existing one; task.code plans CMP-4 as a new tests/test_risk.py.

open_questions: CQ-DS-1: please confirm the test file split at review. The new tests/test_risk.py holds the STORY-03 tests; the STORY-04 tests are added to tests/test_forecast.py.
UT-1: AC-03.5 (PQ-1), AC-03.6 (TQ-5) and AC-04.5 (TQ-4) are tested against interim answers. If any answer changes, the matching assertion must change too.
Carried from task.code, unchanged: CQ-C2 (version 0.10.0), CQ-DS-3, RAQ-1, TQ-8, PQ-5.
